caption:
⚠️ An FBI counterintelligence agent stole $1 MILLION in crypto from a suspect's wallets and asked ChatGPT how to leave the country.

Patrick Yaroch used passcodes obtained during a criminal probe to make a dozen transfers from wallets tied to an "adversarial nation".

He then asked ChatGPT what to do with a "bucket of money" and how to move to Europe, and booked a flight to Portugal after it recommended it.

Yaroch confessed saying he had been "spinning out of control" and it was "eating him up inside."
